issues.title: unsupported claim
issues.reason: The adjective 'secure' implies a measurable closure reliability or safety performance that is not supported by the authorized facts. The facts only confirm the lid type is a 'Screw-top lid', which does not inherently prove it is secure for travel without further evidence of leak resistance or locking mechanism.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the subjective adjective 'Secure' or provide verified evidence of the lid's security/leak-resistance performance.
